summary_en: 3,335 shares (0.06% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled as of 2026-09-01 upon completion of stock exchange with Kobe Steel whereby Kobe Steel acquires all issued shares of the filer.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-05, Kobelco Wire Company's board resolved to cancel all treasury stock held by the company, effective 2026-09-01. The cancellation is mandated under the stock exchange agreement with Kobe Steel (announced 2026-05-11), under which Kobe Steel will acquire all issued shares of Kobelco Wire on a simplified stock-swap basis. As of 2026-06-30, the company held 3,335 treasury shares out of 5,912,999 total issued shares. These shares will be cancelled immediately before the stock exchange is completed and Kobe Steel obtains full ownership.
